title: Proto Labs Positioned For Growth: Analyst Predicts Strong Gains Amid Digital Manufacturing Surge
description:
Cantor Fitzgerald analyst Troy Jensen initiated coverage on Proto Labs, Inc. (NYSE:PRLB) with an Overweight rating and price target of $44.00.
The analyst writes that the company is well-placed to capitalize on a growing market and capture increased growth in production applications. With its hybrid business model offering in-house manufacturing and a network of suppliers, Proto Labs stands out in the digital manufacturing market, says the analyst.

title: La start-up française Otrera lève 2,5 M€ pour accélérer le développement de réacteurs nucléaires modulaires de nouvelle génération
description: Otrera, a French startup and spin-off of the French Alternative Energies and Atomic Energy Commission (CEA), has raised €2.5 million in its first funding round. The investment consortium includes industrial and financial investors such as Exergon, Invest For The Future, CEA Investissement, RÉEL International, Groupe ADF, EKIUM-Groupe SNEF, AXE CAPITOLE, and FORTIL. The funding will be used to accelerate the development of Otrera's Sodium Fast Reactor (SFR) technology, a modular and revolutionary nuclear reactor designed to address energy sovereignty and industrial decarbonization challenges.

title: French Startup Otrera secures €2.5M to drive development of modular, next-generation nuclear reactors
description: Otrera, a French startup, has raised €2.5 million to develop its Sodium Fast Reactor (SFR), a modular nuclear technology designed to address energy sovereignty and industrial decarbonization. The funding round included investments from industrial and financial partners, positioning Otrera to become a key player in the European energy transition.
